name: hotclip
title_zh: 长视频不出本机，剪成带卡拉OK字幕的竖屏爆点
tagline_zh: 切片工具满地都是，但敢把未发布的素材传上去吗？它端侧转写、LLM 找高光、9:16 重构、卡拉OK字幕，每条还打病毒潜力分，全程不出你的机器。
tagline_en: Cuts long videos and livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe, karaoke captions, per-clip virality scores.
desc_en: Turn long videos & livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts, 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe with karaoke captions, and a per-clip render-QA report. Use when the user asks to clip / cut / 切片 / 剪 a long video, podcast or stream replay into short clips, find highlights / 爆点 in a video, or transcribe a media file. Footage never leaves the machine.
why_zh: 「100% 本地」是它最狠的点：碰未公开素材时，这一条比精度更值钱。
why_en: Fully local, nothing uploaded — clip tools are everywhere, but few will touch your unreleased footage without phoning home.
limit_zh: 装 skill 还不够：得先 git clone 仓库再 pnpm install，首次跑自动下约 1GB 的 ASR 模型。高光检测要一个 OpenAI 兼容端点，接云端时转写文本会出机器（媒体文件不会），本地则要自己起 Ollama。
limit_en: Installing the skill is not enough: git clone the repo and pnpm install, and the first run pulls a ~1GB ASR model. Highlight detection needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — with a cloud one the transcript text does leave the machine.
title_en: Local long-video to vertical shorts with karaoke captions
